alternatives: allocate by exposed population and verified service capacity
protect minimum coverage before assigning remaining resources
reallocate daily using observed utilization and updated heat conditions
assumptions: Heat indicators are aligned to a declared local time zone and spatial support.
Cooling capacity, costs, and response effects remain explicit planning inputs.
All alternatives, capacities, costs, effects, thresholds, and failure scenarios are proposed until bound to evidence.
baseline: Teams and supplies follow the existing equal-share distribution rule.

constraints.description: No high-vulnerability service area may fall below the declared minimum response coverage.
Every released metric must retain evidence type, source lineage, geography, time, assumptions, and uncertainty.
No analytical output may bypass lawful authority, accountable human review, or an applicable appeal process.

decision_cadence: event-triggered and reviewed at the stated decision horizon
decision_owner: chief resilience officer and public-health incident lead
decision_question: How should limited outreach teams, transport slots, and cooling supplies be distributed during a heat emergency?

independence_key.binding_constraint: No high-vulnerability service area may fall below the declared minimum response coverage.
independence_key.evidence_gate: Coverage denominators, vulnerability attributes, and minimum-service rules are complete and policy-approved.
independence_key.intervention_mechanism: equity-constrained resource allocation across service areas
independence_key.primary_outcome: high-risk residents without assigned heat-response capacity

intended_claim: A versioned allocate design for comparing declared alternatives affecting heat-emergency outreach and cooling resources, conditional on its evidence gate.
limitations: This library record has no city binding and therefore reports no local input, output, or recommendation.
Readiness describes explicit source and method gates; it does not certify implementation feasibility.
External domain, legal, community, security, and operational review remains outside this design artifact.

objectives.metric: high-risk residents without assigned heat-response capacity
distributional gap in high-risk residents without assigned heat-response capacity
decision claims with complete evidence lineage

prohibited_claims: Do not describe an optimized allocation as delivered services or reduced mortality.
Do not describe a design-only record as a city execution, deployment, adopted policy, or impact result.
Do not relabel proposed, estimated, simulated, optimized, or causal evidence as observed evidence.
Do not infer individual behavior, protected status, harm, or entitlement from aggregate records.

release_gate.failure_release: Release an explicit insufficient-evidence record naming missing sources, failed diagnostics, prohibited claims, and the next validation action.
release_gate.pass_condition: Coverage denominators, vulnerability attributes, and minimum-service rules are complete and policy-approved.

title: Allocate heat-response teams and cooling supplies
transportability_risks: Building stock, acclimatization, canopy, humidity, and reporting behavior vary by city.
Thresholds calibrated in one climate zone may not transfer to another.
